title: Grim Dawn
notes:
wayland/mangowm: need to start mangohud first, or it will not open in fullscreen. Can still switch to full screen by using window manager keybind. Also disable sync in mangohud (otherwise black screen).

Also need to disable global monitor scaling, and launch via linux compatibility option in steam. 
Cinematics (on campaign start and end, a few minutes) are glitchy, skip and watch on youtube.
